rules.title: Honours Research: 0-6 credits from the following
3 credits of statistics from the following (or equivalent)
Students must complete 6 credits of Honours research between their two Joint Honours components
If the second Joint Honours component requires 0 credits of Honours research, the student must take 6 credits of ENVR Honours research
If the second Joint Honours component requires 3 credits of Honours research, the student must take 3 credits of ENVR Honours research
If the second Joint Honours component requires 6 credits of Honours research, the student is not required to take any credits of ENVR Honours research
